context.description: An actor error ends its unit or its run, never strands it

evidence.trustReason: Given/When: inject one dying task supervisor, run supervisor and run actor into real harness/Recorder paths. Then: task path asserts one failed fact per ready unit with exact harness error, final failed fold and no restart. Run supervisor path asserts job fiber completion, logs, empty stable store and released lease; run actor path asserts supervisor wait, error snapshot, record refusal, stable facts, log and release. Later slice path publishes live facts, proves healthy resume and broken fold, then asserts sliceOf selects new, logs defect and headerParts names new run. Focused bun test: 4 pass, 49 assertions. The impossible broken plan requires the exported command seam rather than a loadable /task fixture.

context.gherkin:
Scenario: SV26 An actor error ends its unit or its run, never strands it
    Given a live run whose task supervisor, run supervisor or run actor reaches the error status
    When the error happens
    Then a failed unit supervisor counts as three worker failures, so its unit records task.failed with "harness error: <defect>"
    And a failed run supervisor or run actor ends the job's wait, the Recorder stores nothing more, the defect is logged and the directory lease is released
    And a later /task on that spec treats a slice whose fold dies as ended, logs it, and says in its start message that it starts a new slice

  @phase2 @integrity
